hook: Paul's second letter to the Corinthians.
intro: Second Corinthians is Paul's most personal letter, written to a church that had hurt him, and that he still loved.
Chapters one to seven explain his ministry: comfort in trouble, and treasure in clay jars. Chapters eight and nine are about generous giving.
Chapters ten to thirteen defend his work against false teachers, and share his weakness.
Paul wrote it soon after First Corinthians.
Listen for what God told Paul in chapter twelve: My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness.

card.parts: Ch. 1–7: comfort and ministry | Ch. 8–9: generous giving | Ch. 10–13: strength in weakness
